title: The Event Horizon Telescope's 2022 Sagittarius A* image
summary: The 2022 paper reports an image of the shadow of the Milky Way's central black hole.
body: In 2022 the Event Horizon Telescope Collaboration published "First Sagittarius A* Event Horizon Telescope Results. I. The Shadow of the Supermassive Black Hole in the Center of the Milky Way." The v1 article named Sagittarius A* as the Milky Way's central black hole and dated the first direct image (M87) to 2019. Both points now have collaboration papers. The 2022 paper is the one about Sagittarius A*.
